sources.label: Medium

sources.label: Moderate and slow

newSources.label: difficult

carpeting plants do best under high light, which typically needs CO2 and a rigid fertilizer schedule

items.name: Dwarf hairgrass (Eleocharis)

items.name: Amazon frogbit (floating)

items.name: Cryptocoryne (wendtii / parva)

sources.label: Very easy

beginner-friendly but notorious for melt; recovers
relatively easy but sensitive to change; emersed-grown leaves melt; consistency matters

sources.why: needs more light (40-100 PAR), very slow, active soil or root tabs

items.name: Red stem plant (Ludwigia / Alternanthera / Rotala red)

sources.label: Easy (repens, palustris); easy to moderate (Super Red, Rubin); moderate (arcuata)

items.reason: Staying alive is easy (1) but a good red look needs bright light, iron and nitrate tuning (2); plain green-red Ludwigia repens is easier, reineckii and Super Red harder.

items.name: Pothos (riparium / hanging on the tank)

easy to grow; keep leaves above water; toxic to pets; roots overgrow and can starve other plants; submerged growth poor

items.reason: Easy as long as only roots are wet and leaves stay dry; two sources, no disagreement but both hobby/retail sites.
